items.quote: There are two ways to access the Copper Developer API: API keys and OAuth2.0.
items.why: States two access methods: API keys and OAuth2.0.

items.quote: To use OAuth2.0 with Copper, you must first register your application.
items.why: Shows OAuth2 needs registration, but not that it is an auth method or the email process.

items.quote: Only Admin users are able to generate API Keys.
items.why: Admin-only key generation is consistent with the claim, but says nothing about self-serve or free access.

items.quote: Start free, no credit card required.
items.why: Free trial with no card is related, but not a statement about API access being free or self-serve.

items.quote: All API calls are limited to 180 requests per minute.
items.why: Only a rate limit. Says nothing about REST or broad API coverage.

items.quote: Yes. Copper is launching an official MCP server, built and hosted by Copper. The beta launches in November 2026.
items.why: Says MCP is official and Copper-hosted, contradicting vendor-official False. Beta timing is not in the claim.
